verdict.rationale: Render's docs list a REST API section, and a probe confirmed a public OpenAPI spec at render.com/openapi.json, so the product exposes a documented, machine-readable public API that an AI-native user can drive programmatically. The evidence shows the API exists but says little about its scope or operation. missing for 10: evidence of endpoint coverage (which resources and actions the API can manage), authentication/API-key documentation details, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Render via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
